clues.text: With an 85-foot lift hill and a top speed of 56 mph, this classic wooden coaster features zero inversions.
This wooden coaster was built by Philadelphia Toboggan Coasters and officially opened in 1975.
You can find this twin wooden coaster operating in the state of Virginia.
This attraction was officially designated an ACE Roller Coaster Landmark by the American Coaster Enthusiasts in June 2003.
The ride's name combines a term for a speed competitor with the two-digit year of its opening season.
